description: This PHP class defines the CloudFrontKeyValueStoreClient, a client to interact with the Amazon CloudFront KeyValueStore service, providing methods for key management operations.

classes.name: CloudFrontKeyValueStoreClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon CloudFront KeyValueStore service, extending the generic AwsClient.

methods.name: deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a specified key from the CloudFront KeyValueStore.

methods.name: deleteKeyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a key from the CloudFront KeyValueStore.

methods.name: describeKeyValueStore
methods.description: Retrieves details about the CloudFront KeyValueStore.

methods.name: describeKeyValueStoreAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details about the CloudFront KeyValueStore.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Retrieves a specific key from the CloudFront KeyValueStore.

methods.name: getKeyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a specific key from the CloudFront KeyValueStore.

methods.name: listKeys
methods.description: Lists all keys in the CloudFront KeyValueStore.

methods.name: listKeysAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all keys in the CloudFront KeyValueStore.

methods.name: putKey
methods.description: Adds or updates a key in the CloudFront KeyValueStore.

methods.name: putKeyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds or updates a key in the CloudFront KeyValueStore.

methods.name: updateKeys
methods.description: Updates multiple keys in the CloudFront KeyValueStore.

methods.name: updateKeysAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates multiple keys in the CloudFront KeyValueStore.
